calendar: Roman Republican calendar; exact historical dates are used where known, while generated simulation dates are explicitly labeled.
latest_player_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius begins the next major part of his expedition by leaving the ravine fortress under a reliable garrison and taking the main body deeper into the territory used by the regional band. He advances through several routes at once, using scouts trained in July to compare roads, water sources, settlements and concealed approaches before committing the column. He intends to find and break the band's wider network rather than chase isolated parties, while keeping the fortress and estate road behind him as a secure line of supply.

special_event_policy.dry_spell_adjustment: After 3 consecutive rounds without a standard special event, +2 percentage points; +4 after 4; +6 after 5+, capped at 18%. This does not affect Magnitude 11.
special_event_policy.rarity_rule: Standard Magnitudes 1-10 use the inverse-Change-Index distribution. Magnitude 11 is independently randomized each round.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_probability_rule: Each round samples a new Magnitude 11 chance uniformly from 0%-18%, then performs three independent checks at that sampled percentage.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_dry_spell_interaction: None; Magnitude 11 chance is independently randomized each round.
